Vehaser kaas millibbecha vehaaver raa mibbesarecha ki-hayyaldut vehashshacharut havel
Uzchor et-borecha bime bechurotecha ad asher lo-yavou yeme haraa vehiggiu shanim asher tomar en-li vahem chefetz
Ad asher lo-techshach hashshemesh vehaor vehayyareach vehakkochavim veshavu heavim achar haggashem
Bayyom sheyyazuu shomre habbayit vehitavvetu anshe hechayil uvatlu hattochanot ki mietu vechashchu haroot baarubbot
Vesuggeru delatayim bashshuk bishfal kol hattachana veyakum lekol hatztzippor veyishshachu kal-benot hashshir
Gam miggavoha yirau vechatchattim badderech veyanetz hashshaked veyistabbel hechagav vetafer haaviyyona ki-holech haadam el-bet olamo vesavvu vashshuk hassofdim
Ad asher yeratek chevel hakkesef vetarutz gullat hazzahav vetishshaver kad al-hammabbua venarotz haggalgal el-habbor
Veyashov heafar al-haaretz keshehaya veharuach tashuv el-haelohim asher netanah
Havel havalim amar hakkohelet hakkol havel
Veyoter shehaya kohelet chacham od limmad-daat et-haam veizzen vechikker tikken meshalim harbe
Bikkesh kohelet limtzo divre-chefetz vechatuv yosher divre emet
Divre chachamim kaddarvonot uchmasmerot netuim baale asuppot nittenu meroe echad
Veyoter mehemma beni hizzaher asot sefarim harbe en ketz velahag harbe yegiat basar
Sof davar hakkol nishma et-haelohim yera veet-mitzotav shemor ki-ze kal-haadam
Ki et-kal-maase haelohim yavi vemishpat al kal-nelam im-tov veim-rasf dvr hchl nshm t-hlhm yr vt-mtztv shmr chy-z chl-hdm
Esther: Vayehi bime achashverosh hu achashverosh hammolech mehoddu vead-kush sheva veesrim umea medina
Bayyamim hahem keshevet hammelech achashverosh al kisse malchuto asher beshushan habbira
Bishnat shalosh lemalcho asa mishte lechal-sarav vaavadav chel paras umaday happartemim vesare hammedinot lefanav
Beharoto et-osher kevod malchuto veet-yekar tiferet gedullato yamim rabbim shemonim umat yom
Uvimlot hayyamim haelle asa hammelech lechal-haam hannimtzeim beshushan habbira lemiggadol vead-katan mishte shivat yamim bachatzar ginnat bitan hammelech
Chur karpas utchelet achuz bechavle-vutz veargaman al-gelile chesef veammude shesh mittot zahav vachesef al ritzfat bahat-vashesh vedar vesocharet
Vehashkot bichle zahav vechelim mikkelim shonim veyen malchut rav keyad hammelech
Vehashshetiyya chaddat en ones ki-chen yissad hammelech al kal-rav beto laasot kirtzon ish-vaish
Gam vashti hammalka asta mishte nashim bet hammalchut asher lammelech achashverosh
Bayyom hashshevii ketov lev-hammelech bayyayin amar limhuman bizzeta charvona bigta vaavagta zetar vecharkas shivat hassarisim hamshartim et-pene hammelech achashverosh
Lehavi et-vashti hammalka lifne hammelech becheter malchut leharot haammim vehassarim et-yafyah ki-tovat mare hi
Vattemaen hammalka vashti lavo bidvar hammelech asher beyad hassarisim vayyiktzof hammelech meod vachamato baara vo
Vayyomer hammelech lachachamim yode haittim ki-chen devar hammelech lifne kal-yode dat vadin
Vehakkarov elav karshena shetar admata tarshish meres marsena memuchan shivat sare paras umaday roe pene hammelech hayyoshvim rishona bammalchut
Kedat ma-laasot bammalka vashti al asher lo-asta et-maamar hammelech achashverosh beyad hassarisim
Vayyomer memuchan lifne hammelech vehassarim lo al-hammelech levaddo aveta vashti hammalka ki al-kal-hassarim veal-kal-haammim asher bechal-medinot hammelech achashverosh
Ki-yetze devar-hammalka al-kal-hannashim lehavzot balehen beenehen beamram hammelech achashverosh amar lehavi et-vashti hammalka lefanav velo-vaa
Vehayyom hazze tomarna sarot paras-umaday asher shamu et-devar hammalka lechol sare hammelech uchday bizzaon vakatzef
Im-al-hammelech tov yetze devar-malchut millefanav veyikkatev bedate faras-umaday velo yaavor asher lo-tavo vashti lifne hammelech achashverosh umalchutah yitten hammelech lirutah hattova mimmenna
Venishma pitgam hammelech asher-yaase bechal-malchuto ki rabba hi vechal-hannashim yittenu yekar levalehen lemiggadol vead-katan
Vayyitav haddavar beene hammelech vehassarim vayyaas hammelech kidvar memuchan
Vayyishlach sefarim el-kal-medinot hammelech el-medina umdina kichtavah veel-am vaam kilshono lihot kal-ish sorer beveto umdabber kilshon ammo
Achar haddevarim haelle keshoch chamat hammelech achashverosh zachar et-vashti veet asher-asata veet asher-nigzar aleha
Vayyomru naare-hammelech meshartav yevakshu lammelech nearot betulot tovot mare
Veyafked hammelech pekidim bechal-medinot malchuto veyikbetzu et-kal-naara-vetula tovat mare el-shushan habbira el-bet hannashim el-yad hege seris hammelech shomer hannashim venaton tamrukehen
Vehannaara asher titav beene hammelech timloch tachat vashti vayyitav haddavar beene hammelech vayyaas ken
Ish yehudi haya beshushan habbira ushmo mardochay ben yair ben-shimi ben-kish ish yemini
Asher hagla mirushalayim im-haggola asher hagleta im yechanya melech-yehuda asher hegla nevuchadnetzar melech bavel
Vayehi omen et-hadassa hi ester bat-dodo ki en lah av vaem vehannaara yefat-toar vetovat mare uvmot aviha veimmah lekachah mardochay lo levat
Vayehi behishshama devar-hammelech vedato uvhikkavetz nearot rabbot el-shushan habbira el-yad hegay vattillakach ester el-bet hammelech el-yad hegay shomer hannashim
Vattitav hannaara veenav vattissa chesed lefanav vayevahel et-tamrukeha veet-manoteha latet lah veet sheva hannearot haruot latet-lah mibbet hammelech vayeshanneha veet-naaroteha letov bet hannashim
Lo-higgida ester et-ammah veet-moladtah ki mardochay tziva aleha asher lo-taggid
Uvchal-yom vaom mardochay mithallech lifne chatzar bet-hannashim ladaat et-shelom ester uma-yease bah

Uvhaggia tor naara venaara lavo el-hammelech achashverosh mikketz heot lah kedat hannashim shenem asar chodesh ki ken yimleu yeme merukehen shishsha chodashim beshemen hammor veshishsha chodashim babbesamim uvtamruke hannashim
Uvaze hannaara baa el-hammelech et kal-asher tomar yinnaten lah lavo immah mibbet hannashim ad-bet hammelech
Baerev hi vaa uvabboker hi shava el-bet hannashim sheni el-yad shaashgaz seris hammelech shomer happilagshim lo-tavo od el-hammelech ki im-chafetz bah hammelech venikrea veshem

Uvhaggia tor-ester bat-avichayil dod mardochay asher lakach-lo levat lavo el-hammelech lo viksha davar ki im et-asher yomar hegay seris-hammelech shomer hannashim vattehi ester noset chen beene kal-roeha
Vattillakach ester el-hammelech achashverosh el-bet malchuto bachodesh haasiri hu-chodesh tevet bishnat-sheva lemalchuto
Vayyeehav hammelech et-ester mikkal-hannashim vattissa-chen vachesed lefanav mikkal-habbetulot vayyasem keter-malchut beroshah vayyamlicheha tachat vashti
Vayyaas hammelech mishte gadol lechal-sarav vaavadav et mishte ester vahanacha lammedinot asa vayyitten maset keyad hammelech
Uvhikkavetz betulot shenit umardochay yoshev beshaar-hammelech
En ester maggedet moladtah veet-ammah kaasher tziva aleha mardochay veet-maamar mardochay ester osa kaasher hayeta veamna itto
Bayyamim hahem umardochay yoshev beshaar-hammelech katzaf bigtan vateresh shene-sarise hammelech mishshomre hassaf vayevakshu lishloach yad bammelech achashverosh
Vayyivada haddavar lemardochay vayyagged leester hammalka vattomer ester lammelech beshem mardochay
Vayevukkash haddavar vayyimmatze vayyittalu shenehem al-etz vayyikkatev besefer divre hayyamim lifne hammelech
Achar haddevarim haelle giddal hammelech achashverosh et-haman ben-hammedata haagagi vayenasseehu vayyasem et-kiso meal kal-hassarim asher itto
Vechal-avde hammelech asher-beshaar hammelech korim umishtachavim lehaman ki-chen tziva-lo hammelech umardochay lo yichra velo yishtachave
Vayyomru avde hammelech asher-beshaar hammelech lemardochay maddua atta over et mitzvat hammelech
Vayehi keamram elav yom vaom velo shama alehem vayyaggidu lehaman lirot hayaamdu divre mardochay ki-higgid lahem asher-hu yehudi
Vayyar haman ki-en mardochay korea umishtachave lo vayyimmale haman chema
Vayyivez beenav lishloch yad bemardochay levaddo ki-higgidu lo et-am mardochay vayevakkesh haman lehashmid et-kal-hayehudim asher bechal-malchut achashverosh am mardochay
Bachodesh harishon hu-chodesh nisan bishnat shettem esre lammelech achashverosh hippil pur hu haggoral lifne haman miyyom leom umechodesh lechodesh shenem-asar hu-chodesh adar
Vayyomer haman lammelech achashverosh yeshno am-echad mefuzzar umforad ben haammim bechol medinot malchutecha vedatehem shonot mikkal-am veet-date hammelech enam osim velammelech en-shove lehannicham
Im-al-hammelech tov yikkatev leabbedam vaaseret alafim kikkar-kesef eshkol al-yede ose hammelacha lehavi el-ginze hammelech
Vayyasar hammelech et-tabbato meal yado vayyittenah lehaman ben-hammedata haagagi tzorer hayehudim
Vayyomer hammelech lehaman hakkesef natun lach vehaam laasot bo kattov beenecha

Vayyikkaru sofre hammelech bachodesh harishon bishlosha asar yom bo vayyikkatev kechal-asher-tziva haman el achashdarpene-hammelech veel-happachot asher al-medina umdina veel-sare am vaam medina umdina kichtavah veam vaam kilshono beshem hammelech achashverosh nichtav venechtam betabbaat hammelech

Venishloach sefarim beyad haratzim el-kal-medinot hammelech lehashmid laharog ulabbed et-kal-hayehudim minnaar vead-zaken taf venashim beom echad bishlosha asar lechodesh shenem-asar hu-chodesh adar ushlalam lavoz
Patshegen hakketav lehinnaten dat bechal-medina umdina galuy lechal-haammim lihot atidim layyom hazze
Haratzim yatzu dechufim bidvar hammelech vehaddat nittena beshushan habbira vehammelech vehaman yashvu lishtot vehair shushan navocha
Umardochay yada et-kal-asher naasa vayyikra mardochay et-begadav vayyilbash sak vaefer vayyetze betoch hair vayyizak zeaka gedola umara
Vayyavo ad lifne shaar-hammelech ki en lavo el-shaar hammelech bilvush sak
Uvchal-medina umdina mekom asher devar-hammelech vedato maggia evel gadol layehudim vetzom uvchi umisped sak vaefer yutztza larabbim
Vattavoyna naarot ester vesariseha vayyaggidu lah vattitchalchal hammalka meod vattishlach begadim lehalbish et-mardochay ulhasir sakko mealav velo kibbel
Vattikra ester lahatach missarise hammelech asher heemid lefaneha vattetzavehu al-mardochay ladaat ma-ze veal-ma-ze
Vayyetze hatach el-mardochay el-rechov hair asher lifne shaar-hammelech
Vayyagged-lo mardochay et kal-asher karahu veet parashat hakkesef asher amar haman lishkol al-ginze hammelech bayehudim leabbedam
Veet-patshegen ketav-haddat asher-nittan beshushan lehashmidam natan lo leharot et-ester ulhaggid lah ultzauot aleha lavo el-hammelech lehitchannen-lo ulvakkesh millefanav al-ammah
Vayyavo hatach vayyagged leester et divre mardochay
Vattomer ester lahatach vattetzavehu el-mardochay

Kal-avde hammelech veam-medinot hammelech yodim asher kal-ish veishsha asher yavo-el-hammelech el-hechatzer happenimit asher lo-yikkare achat dato lehamit levad measher yoshit-lo hammelech et-sharvit hazzahav vechaya vaani lo nikrety lavo el-hammelech ze sheloshim yom
Vayyaggidu lemardochay et divre ester
Vayyomer mardochay lehashiv el-ester al-tedammi venafshech lehimmalet bet-hammelech mikkal-hayehudim
Ki im-hacharesh tacharishi baet hazzot revach vehatztzala yaamod layehudim mimmakom acher veatte uvet-avich tovedu umi yodea im-leet kazot higgaatte lammalchut
Vattomer ester lehashiv el-mardochay

Lech kenos et-kal-hayehudim hannimtzeim beshushan vetzumu alay veal-tochlu veal-tishtu sheloshet yamim layela vaom gam-ani venaarotay atzum ken uvchen avo el-hammelech asher lo-chaddat vechaasher avadti avadti
Vayyaavor mardochay vayyaas kechol asher-tzivveta alav ester
Vayehi bayyom hashshelishi vattilbash ester malchut vattaamod bachatzar bet-hammelech happenimit nochach bet hammelech vehammelech yoshev al-kisse malchuto bevet hammalchut nochach petach habbayit
Vayehi chirot hammelech et-ester hammalka omedet bechatzer nasa chen beenav vayyoshet hammelech leester et-sharvit hazzahav asher beyado vattikrav ester vattigga berosh hashsharvit
Vayyomer lah hammelech ma-lach ester hammalka uma-bakkashatech ad-chatzi hammalchut veyinnaten lach
Vattomer ester im-al-hammelech tov yavo hammelech vehaman hayyom el-hammishte asher-asiti lo
Vayyomer hammelech maharu et-haman laasot et-devar ester vayyavo hammelech vehaman el-hammishte asher-asta ester
Vayyomer hammelech leester bemishte hayyayin ma-sheelatech veyinnaten lach uma-bakkashatech ad-chatzi hammalchut veteas
Vattaan ester vattomar sheelati uvakkashati
Im-matzati chen beene hammelech veim-al-hammelech tov latet et-sheelati velaasot et-bakkashati yavo hammelech vehaman el-hammishte asher eese lahem umachar eese kidvar hammelech
Vayyetze haman bayyom hahu sameach vetov lev vechirot haman et-mardochay beshaar hammelech velo-kam velo-za mimmennu vayyimmale haman al-mardochay chema
Vayyitappak haman vayyavo el-beto vayyishlach vayyave et-ohavav veet-zeresh ishto
Vayesapper lahem haman et-kevod ashro verov banav veet kal-asher giddelo hammelech veet asher nisseo al-hassarim veavde hammelech
Vayyomer haman af lo-hevia ester hammalka im-hammelech el-hammishte asher-asata ki im-oti vegam-lemachar ani karu-lah im-hammelech
Vechal-ze enennu shove li bechal-et asher ani roe et-mardochay hayehudi yoshev beshaar hammelech

Vattomer lo zeresh ishto vechal-ohavav yaasu-etz gavoha chamishshim amma uvabboker emor lammelech veyitlu et-mardochay alav uvo-im-hammelech el hammishte sameach vayyitav haddavar lifne haman vayyaas haetz
Ballayela hahu nadda shenat hammelech vayyomer lehavi et-sefer hazzichronot divre hayyamim vayyihu nikraim lifne hammelech
Vayyimmatze chatuv asher higgid mardochay al-bigtana vateresh shene sarise hammelech mishshomre hassaf asher bikshu lishloach yad bammelech achashverosh
Vayyomer hammelech ma-naasa yekar ugdulla lemardochay al-ze vayyomru naare hammelech meshartav lo-naasa immo davar
Vayyomer hammelech mi vechatzer vehaman ba lachatzar bet-hammelech hachitzona lemor lammelech litlot et-mardochay al-haetz asher-hechin lo
Vayyomru naare hammelech elav hinne haman omed bechatzer vayyomer hammelech yavo
Vayyavo haman vayyomer lo hammelech ma-laasot baish asher hammelech chafetz bikaro vayyomer haman belibbo lemi yachpotz hammelech laasot yekar yoter mimmenni
Vayyomer haman el-hammelech ish asher hammelech chafetz bikaro
Yaviu levush malchut asher lavash-bo hammelech vesus asher rachav alav hammelech vaasher nittan keter malchut berosho

Venaton hallevush vehassus al-yad-ish missare hammelech happartemim vehilbishu et-haish asher hammelech chafetz bikaro vehirkivuhu al-hassus birchov hair vekaru lefanav kacha yease laish asher hammelech chafetz bikaro
Vayyomer hammelech lehaman maher kach et-hallevush veet-hassus kaasher dibbarta vaase-chen lemardochay hayehudi hayyoshev beshaar hammelech al-tappel davar mikkol asher dibbarta
Vayyikkach haman et-hallevush veet-hassus vayyalbesh et-mardochay vayyarkivehu birchov hair vayyikra lefanav kacha yease laish asher hammelech chafetz bikaro
Vayyashav mardochay el-shaar hammelech vehaman nidchaf el-beto avel vachafuy rosh

Vayesapper haman lezeresh ishto ulchal-ohavav et kal-asher karahu vayyomru lo chachamav vezeresh ishto im mizzera hayehudim mardochay asher hachillota linpol lefanav lo-tuchal lo ki-nafol tippol lefanav
Odam medabberim immo vesarise hammelech higgiu vayyavhilu lehavi et-haman el-hammishte asher-asta ester
Vayyavo hammelech vehaman lishtot im-ester hammalka
Vayyomer hammelech leester gam bayyom hashsheni bemishte hayyayin ma-sheelatech ester hammalka vetinnaten lach uma-bakkashatech ad-chatzi hammalchut veteas
Vattaan ester hammalka vattomar im-matzati chen beenecha hammelech veim-al-hammelech tov tinnaten-li nafshi bishelati veammi bevakkashati
Ki nimkarnu ani veammi lehashmid laharog ulabbed veillu laavadim velishfachot nimkarnu hecherashti ki en hatztzar shove benezek hammelech
Vayyomer hammelech achashverosh vayyomer leester hammalka mi hu ze vee-ze hu asher-melao libbo laasot ken
Vattomer-ester ish tzar veoyev haman hara hazze vehaman nivat millifne hammelech vehammalka
Vehammelech kam bachamato mimmishte hayyayin el-ginnat habbitan vehaman amad levakkesh al-nafsho meester hammalka ki raa ki-chalta elav haraa meet hammelech

Vehammelech shav migginnat habbitan el-bet mishte hayyayin vehaman nofel al-hammitta asher ester aleha vayyomer hammelech hagam lichbosh et-hammalka immi babbayit haddavar yatza mippi hammelech ufne haman chafu

Vayyomer charvona echad min-hassarisim lifne hammelech gam hinne-haetz asher-asa haman lemardochay asher dibber-tov al-hammelech omed bevet haman gavoha chamishshim amma vayyomer hammelech teluhu alav
Vayyitlu et-haman al-haetz asher-hechin lemardochay vachamat hammelech shachacha
Bayyom hahu natan hammelech achashverosh leester hammalka et-bet haman tzorer hayehudim umardochay ba lifne hammelech ki-higgida ester ma hu-lah
Vayyasar hammelech et-tabbato asher heevir mehaman vayyittenah lemardochay vattasem ester et-mardochay al-bet haman
Vattosef ester vattedabber lifne hammelech vattippol lifne raglav vattevke vattitchannen-lo lehaavir et-raat haman haagagi veet machashavto asher chashav al-hayehudim
Vayyoshet hammelech leester et sharvit hazzahav vattakam ester vattaamod lifne hammelech

Vattomer im-al-hammelech tov veim-matzati chen lefanav vechasher haddavar lifne hammelech vetova ani beenav yikkatev lehashiv et-hassefarim machashevet haman ben-hammedata haagagi asher katav leabbed et-hayehudim asher bechal-medinot hammelech
Ki echacha uchal veraiti baraa asher-yimtza et-ammi veechacha uchal veraiti beavdan moladti
Vayyomer hammelech achashverosh leester hammalka ulmardochay hayehudi hinne vet-haman natatti leester veoto talu al-haetz al asher-shalach yado bayehudim
Veattem kitvu al-hayehudim kattov beenechem beshem hammelech vechitmu betabbaat hammelech ki-chetav asher-nichtav beshem-hammelech venachtom betabbaat hammelech en lehashiv

Vayyikkaru sofre-hammelech baet-hahi bachodesh hashshelishi hu-chodesh sivan bishlosha veesrim bo vayyikkatev kechal-asher-tziva mardochay el-hayehudim veel haachashdarpenim-vehappachot vesare hammedinot asher mehoddu vead-kush sheva veesrim umea medina medina umdina kichtavah veam vaam kilshono veel-hayehudim kichtavam vechilshonam
Vayyichtov beshem hammelech achashverosh vayyachtom betabbaat hammelech vayyishlach sefarim beyad haratzim bassusim rochve harechesh haachashteranim bene harammachim
Asher natan hammelech layehudim asher bechal-ir-vair lehikkahel velaamod al-nafsham lehashmid velaharog ulabbed et-kal-chel am umdina hatztzarim otam taf venashim ushlalam lavoz
Beom echad bechal-medinot hammelech achashverosh bishlosha asar lechodesh shenem-asar hu-chodesh adar
Patshegen hakketav lehinnaten dat bechal-medina umdina galuy lechal-haammim velihot hayehudim atidim layyom hazze lehinnakem meoyevehem
Haratzim rochve harechesh haachashteranim yatzu mevohalim udchufim bidvar hammelech vehaddat nittena beshushan habbira
Umardochay yatza millifne hammelech bilvush malchut techelet vachur vaateret zahav gedola vetachrich butz veargaman vehair shushan tzahala vesamecha
Layehudim hayeta ora vesimcha vesason vikar
Uvchal-medina umdina uvchal-ir vair mekom asher devar-hammelech vedato maggia simcha vesason layehudim mishte veom tov verabbim meamme haaretz mityahadim ki-nafal pachad-hayehudim alehem

Uvishnem asar chodesh hu-chodesh adar bishlosha asar yom bo asher higgia devar-hammelech vedato leheasot bayyom asher sibberu oyeve hayehudim lishlot bahem venahafoch hu asher yishletu hayehudim hemma besonehem
Nikhalu hayehudim bearehem bechal-medinot hammelech ochashverosh lishloach yad bimvakshe raatam veish lo-amad lifnehem ki-nafal pachdam al-kal-haammim
Vechal-sare hammedinot vehaachashdarpenim vehappachot veose hammelacha asher lammelech menasseim et-hayehudim ki-nafal pachad-mardochay alehem
Ki-gadol mardochay bevet hammelech veshamo holech bechal-hammedinot ki-haish mardochay holech vegadol
Vayyakku hayehudim bechal-oyevehem makkat-cherev vehereg veavdan vayyaasu vesonehem kirtzonam
Uvshushan habbira hargu hayehudim veabbed chamesh meot ish
Veet parshandata veet dalfon veet aspata
Veet porata veet adalya veet aridata
Veet parmashta veet arisay veet ariday veet vayezata
Aseret bene haman ben-hammedata tzorer hayehudim haragu uvabbizza lo shalchu et-yadam
Bayyom hahu ba mispar haharugim beshushan habbira lifne hammelech

Vayyomer hammelech leester hammalka beshushan habbira hargu hayehudim veabbed chamesh meot ish veet aseret bene-haman bishar medinot hammelech me asu uma-sheelatech veyinnaten lach uma-bakkashatech od veteas
Vattomer ester im-al-hammelech tov yinnaten gam-machar layehudim asher beshushan laasot kedat hayyom veet aseret bene-haman yitlu al-haetz
Vayyomer hammelech leheasot ken vattinnaten dat beshushan veet aseret bene-haman talu
Vayyikkahalu hayehudim asher-beshushan gam beom arbaa asar lechodesh adar vayyahargu veshushan shelosh meot ish uvabbizza lo shalchu et-yadam
Ushar hayehudim asher bimdinot hammelech nikhalu veamod al-nafsham venoach meoyevehem veharog besonehem chamishsha veshivim alef uvabbizza lo shalchu et-yadam
Beom-shelosha asar lechodesh adar venoach bearbaa asar bo veaso oto yom mishte vesimcha
Vehayehudim asher-beshushan nikhalu bishlosha asar bo uvarbaa asar bo venoach bachamishsha asar bo veaso oto yom mishte vesimcha
Al-ken hayehudim happerazim hayyoshvim beare happerazot osim et yom arbaa asar lechodesh adar simcha umishte veom tov umishloach manot ish lereehu
Vayyichtov mardochay et-haddevarim haelle vayyishlach sefarim el-kal-hayehudim asher bechal-medinot hammelech achashverosh hakkerovim veharchokim
Lekayyem alehem lihot osim et yom arbaa asar lechodesh adar veet yom-chamishsha asar bo bechal-shana veshana
Kayyamim asher-nachu vahem hayehudim meoyevehem vehachodesh asher nehpach lahem miyyagon lesimcha umeevel leom tov laasot otam yeme mishte vesimcha umishloach manot ish lereehu umattanot laevonim
Vekibbel hayehudim et asher-hechellu laasot veet asher-katav mardochay alehem
Ki haman ben-hammedata haagagi tzorer kal-hayehudim chashav al-hayehudim leabbedam vehippil pur hu haggoral lehummam ulabbedam
Uvvoah lifne hammelech amar im-hassefer yashuv machashavto haraa asher-chashav al-hayehudim al-rosho vetalu oto veet-banav al-haetz
Al-ken karu layyamim haelle furim al-shem happur al-ken al-kal-divre haiggeret hazzot uma-rau al-kacha uma higgia alehem
Kiyemu vekibbelu hayehudim alehem veal-zaram veal kal-hannilvim alehem velo yaavor lihot osim et shene hayyamim haelle kichtavam vechizmannam bechal-shana veshana
Vehayyamim haelle nizkarim venaasim bechal-dor vador mishpacha umishpacha medina umdina veir vair vime happurim haelle lo yaavru mittoch hayehudim vezichram lo-yasuf mizzaram
Vattichtov ester hammalka vat-avichayil umardochay hayehudi et-kal-tokef lekayyem et iggeret happurim hazzot hashshenit
Vayyishlach sefarim el-kal-hayehudim el-sheva veesrim umea medina malchut achashverosh divre shalom veemet
Lekayyem et-yeme happurim haelle bizmannehem kaasher kiyyam alehem mardochay hayehudi veester hammalka vechaasher kiyemu al-nafsham veal-zaram divre hatztzomot vezaakatam
Umaamar ester kiyyam divre happurim haelle venichtav bassefer
Vayyasem hammelech achashverosh mas al-haaretz veiyye hayyam
Vechal-maase takpo ugvurato ufarashat gedullat mardochay asher giddelo hammelech halo-hem ketuvim al-sefer divre hayyamim lemalche maday ufaras
Ki mardochay hayehudi mishne lammelech achashverosh vegadol layehudim veratzuy lerov echav doresh tov leammo vedover shalom lechal-zaro
Daniel: Bishnat shalosh lemalchut yehoyakim melech-yehuda ba nevuchadnetzar melech-bavel yerushalam vayyatzar aleha
Vayyitten adonay beyado et-yehoyakim melech-yehuda umiktzat kele vet-haelohim vayeviem eretz-shinar bet elohav veet-hakkelim hevi bet otzar elohav
Vayyomer hammelech leashpenaz rav sarisav lehavi mibbene yisrael umizzera hammelucha umin-happartemim
Yeladim asher en-bahem mum vetove mare umaskilim bechal-chachma veyode daat umvine madda vaasher koach bahem laamod behechal hammelech ulalammedam sefer ulshon kasdim
Vayeman lahem hammelech devar-yom beomo mippat-bag hammelech umiyyen mishtav ulgaddelam shanim shalosh umiktzatam yaamdu lifne hammelech
Vayehi vahem mibbene yehuda daniyyel chananya mishael vaazarya
Vayyasem lahem sar hassarisim shemot vayyasem ledaniyyel belteshatzar velachananya shadrach ulmishael meshach velaazarya aved nego
Vayyasem daniyyel al-libbo asher lo-yitgaal befatbag hammelech uvyen mishtav vayevakkesh missar hassarisim asher lo yitgaal
Vayyitten haelohim et-daniyyel lechesed ulrachamim lifne sar hassarisim

Vayyomer sar hassarisim ledaniyyel yare ani et-adoni hammelech asher minna et-maachalchem veet-mishtechem asher lamma yire et-penechem zoafim min-hayeladim asher kegilchem vechiyyavtem et-roshi lammelech
Vayyomer daniyyel el-hammeltzar asher minna sar hassarisim al-daniyyel chananya mishael vaazarya
Nas-na et-avadecha yamim asara veyittenu-lanu min-hazzeroim venochla umayim venishte
Veyerau lefanecha marenu umare hayeladim haochlim et patbag hammelech vechaasher tire ase im-avadecha
Vayyishma lahem laddavar hazze vayenassem yamim asara
Umiktzat yamim asara nira marehem tov uvrie basar min-kal-hayeladim haochlim et patbag hammelech
Vayehi hammeltzar nose et-patbagam veyen mishtehem venoten lahem zeronim
Vehayeladim haelle arbatam natan lahem haelohim madda vehaskel bechal-sefer vechachma vedaniyyel hevin bechal-chazon vachalomot
Ulmiktzat hayyamim asher-amar hammelech lahaviam vayeviem sar hassarisim lifne nevuchadnetztzar
Vayedabber ittam hammelech velo nimtza mikkullam kedaniyyel chananya mishael vaazarya vayyaamdu lifne hammelech
Vechol devar chachmat bina asher-bikkesh mehem hammelech vayyimtzaem eser yadot al kal-hachartummim haashshafim asher bechal-malchuto
Vayehi daniyyel ad-shenat achat lechoresh hammelech
Uvishnat shettayim lemalchut nevuchadnetztzar chalam nevuchadnetztzar chalomot vattitpaem rucho ushnato nihyeta alav
Vayyomer hammelech likro lachartummim velaashshafim velamchashshefim velakkasdim lehaggid lammelech chalomotav vayyavou vayyaamdu lifne hammelech
Vayyomer lahem hammelech chalom chalamti vattippaem ruchi ladaat et-hachalom
Vayedabberu hakkasdim lammelech aramit malka lealmin cheyi emar chelma leavdach ufishra nechave
Ane malka veamar lechasdae milleta minni azda hen la tehodunnani chelma ufishreh haddamin titavdun uvattechon nevali yittesamun
Vehen chelma ufishreh tehachaon mattenan unvizba vikar saggi tekabbelun min-kodamay lahen chelma ufishreh hachaoni
Ano tinyanut veamrin malka chelma yemar leavdohi ufishra nehachave
Ane malka veamar min-yatztziv yada ana di iddana antun zavnin kal-kovel di chazeton di azda minni milleta
Di hen-chelma la tehodunnani chada-hi datchon umilla chidva ushchita hizdemintun lememar kadamay ad di iddana yishtanne lahen chelma emaru li veinda di fishreh tehachavunnani
Ano chasdae kodam-malka veamrin la-itay anash al-yabbeshta di millat malka yuchal lehachavaya kal-kovel di kal-melech rav veshallit milla chidna la sheel lechal-chartom veashaf vechasday
Umilleta di-malka shael yakkira veachoran la itay di yechavinnah kodam malka lahen elahin di medarhon im-bisra la itohi
Kal-kovel dena malka benas uktzaf saggi vaamar lehovada lechol chakkime vavel
Vedata nefkat vechakkimayya mitkattelin uvo daniyyel vechavrohi lehitketala
Bedayin daniyyel hativ eta utem learoch rav-tabbachayya di malka di nefak lekattala lechakkime bavel
Ane veamar learoch shallita di-malka al-ma data mehachtzefa min-kodam malka edayin milleta hoda aroch ledaniyyel
Vedaniyyel al uva min-malka di zeman yinten-leh ufishra lehachavaya lemalka
Edayin daniyyel levayeteh azal velachananya mishael vaazarya chavrohi milleta hoda
Verachamin lemive min-kodam elah shemayya al-raza dena di la yehovdun daniyyel vechavrohi im-shear chakkime vavel
Edayin ledaniyyel bechezva di-lelya raza gali edayin daniyyel barich leelah shemayya
Ane daniyyel veamar leheve shemeh di-elaha mevarach min-alma vead-alma di chachmeta ugvurta di leh-hi
Vehu mehashne iddanayya vezimnayya mehade malchin umhakem malchin yahev chachmeta lechakkimin umandea leyade vina
Hu gale ammikata umsatterata yada ma vachashocha unhora immeh shere
Lach elah avahati mehode umshabbach ana di chachmeta ugvurta yehavte li uchan hodatani di-veena minnach di-millat malka hodatena
Kal-kovel dena daniyyel al al-aroch di manni malka lehovada lechakkime vavel azal vechen amar-leh lechakkime vavel al-tehoved haelni kodam malka ufishra lemalka achave
Edayin aroch behitbehala hanel ledaniyyel kodam malka vechen amar-leh di-hashkachat gevar min-bene galuta di yehud di fishra lemalka yehoda
Ane malka veamar ledaniyyel di shemeh belteshatzar haitach kahel lehodautani chelma di-chazet ufishreh
Ane daniyyel kodam malka veamar raza di-malka shael la chakkimin ashfin chartummin gazrin yachlin lehachavaya lemalka
Beram itay elah bishmayya gale razin vehoda lemalka nevuchadnetztzar ma di leheve beacharit yomayya chelmach vechezve reshach al-mishkevach dena hu
Ante malka rayonach al-mishkevach seliku ma di leheve achare dena vegale razayya hodach ma-di leheve
Vaana la vechachma di-itay bi min-kal-chayyayya raza dena geli li lahen al-divrat di fishra lemalka yehodun verayone livvach tinda
Ante malka chaze havayeta vaalu tzelem chad saggi tzalma dikken rav veziveh yattir kaem lekavlach vereveh dechil
Hu tzalma resheh di-dehav tav chadohi udraohi di chesaf meohi veyarchateh di nechash
Shakohi di farzel raglohi minnehen di farzel uminnehen di chasaf
Chaze havayeta ad di hitgezeret even di-la vidayin umchat letzalma al-raglohi di farzela vechaspa vehaddeket himmon
Bedayin daku chachada parzela chaspa nechasha kaspa vedahava vahao keur min-iddere-kayit unsa himmon rucha vechal-atar la-hishtachach lehon veavna di-mechat letzalma havat letur rav umlat kal-ara
Dena chelma ufishreh nemar kodam-malka
Ante malka melech malchayya di elah shemayya malchuta chisna vetakpa vikara yehav-lach
Uvchal-di dayerin bene-anasha chevat bara veof-shemayya yehav bidach vehashletach bechallehon ante-hu resha di dahava
Uvatrach tekum malchu achori ara minnach umalchu telitaa achori di nechasha di tishlat bechal-ara
Umalchu reviaa teheve takkifa kefarzela kal-kovel di farzela mehaddek vechashel kolla uchfarzela di-meraa kal-illen taddik veteroa
Vedi-chazayeta raglayya veetzbeata minnehen chasaf di-fechar uminnehen parzel malchu feliga teheve umin-nitzbeta di farzela leheve-vah kal-kovel di chazayeta parzela mearav bachasaf tina
Veetzbeat raglayya minnehen parzel uminnehen chasaf min-ketzat malchuta teheve takkifa uminnah teheve tevira
Vedi chazayeta parzela mearav bachasaf tina mitarvin leheon bizra anasha vela-leheon davkin dena im-dena he-chedi farzela la mitarav im-chaspa
Uvomehon di malchayya innun yekim elah shemayya malchu di lealmin la titchabbal umalchuta leam achoran la tishtevik taddik vetasef kal-illen malchevata vehi tekum lealmayya
Kal-kovel di-chazayeta di mittura itgezeret even di-la vidayin vehaddeket parzela nechasha chaspa kaspa vedahava elah rav hoda lemalka ma di leheve achare dena veyatztziv chelma umheman pishreh
Bedayin malka nevuchadnetztzar nefal al-anpohi uldaniyyel segid umincha venichochin amar lenassacha leh
Ane malka ledaniyyel veamar min-keshot di elahachon hu elah elahin umare malchin vegale razin di yechelta lemigle raza dena
Edayin malka ledaniyyel rabbi umattenan ravrevan saggian yehav-leh vehashleteh al kal-medinat bavel verav-signin al kal-chakkime vavel
Vedaniyyel bea min-malka umanni al avidta di medinat bavel leshadrach meshach vaaved nego vedaniyyel bitra malka
Nevuchadnetztzar malka avad tzelem di-dehav rumeh ammin shittin petayeh ammin shit akimeh bevikat dura bimdinat bavel

Unvuchadnetztzar malka shelach lemichnash laachashdarpenayya signayya ufachavata adargazrayya gedavrayya detavrayya tiftaye vechol shiltone medinata lemete lachanukkat tzalma di hakem nevuchadnetztzar malka

Bedayin mitkanneshin achashdarpenayya signayya ufachavata adargazrayya gedavrayya detavrayya tiftaye vechol shiltone medinata lachanukkat tzalma di hakem nevuchadnetztzar malka vekayemin lakovel tzalma di hakem nevuchadnetztzar
Vecharoza kare vechayil lechon amrin ammayya ummayya velishshanayya
Beiddana di-tishmeun kal karna mashrokita katros sabbecha pesanterin sumponya vechol zene zemara tippelun vetisgedun letzelem dahava di hakem nevuchadnetztzar malka
Uman-di-la yippel veyisgud bah-shaata yitreme lego-attun nura yakidta

Kal-kovel dena beh-zimna kedi shamin kal-ammayya kal karna mashrokita katros sabbecha pesanterin vechol zene zemara naflin kal-ammayya umayya velishshanayya sagdin letzelem dahava di hakem nevuchadnetztzar malka
Kal-kovel dena beh-zimna kerivu guvrin kasdain vaachalu kartzehon di yehudaye
Ano veamrin linvuchadnetztzar malka malka lealmin cheyi
Ante malka samta teem di chal-enash di-yishma kal karna mashrokita katros sabbecha fesanterin vesupponya vechol zene zemara yippel veyisgud letzelem dahava
Uman-di-la yippel veyisgud yitreme lego-attun nura yakidta
Itay guvrin yehudayin di-mannita yathon al-avidat medinat bavel shadrach meshach vaaved nego guvrayya illech la-samu alach malka teem lelahach la falchin ultzelem dahava di hakemta la sagdin
Bedayin nevuchadnetztzar birgaz vachama amar lehayetaya leshadrach meshach vaaved nego bedayin guvrayya illech hetau kodam malka
Ane nevuchadnetztzar veamar lehon hatzda shadrach meshach vaaved nego lelahay la itechon palchin ultzelem dahava di hakemet la sagdin

Kean hen itechon atidin di veiddana di-tishmeun kal karna mashrokita katros sabbecha pesanterin vesumponya vechol zene zemara tippelun vetisgedun letzalma di-avdet vehen la tisgedun bah-shaata titremon lego-attun nura yakidta uman-hu elah de yeshezvinchon min-yeday
Ano shadrach meshach vaaved nego veamrin lemalka nevuchadnetztzar la-chashchin anachna al-dena pitgam lahatavutach
Hen itay elahana di-anachna falchin yachil leshezavutana min-attun nura yakidta umin-yedach malka yesheziv
Vehen la yedia leheve-lach malka di lelahach itana falchin ultzelem dahava di hakemta la nisgud
Bedayin nevuchadnetztzar hitmeli chema utzlem anpohi eshtanni al-shadrach meshach vaaved nego ane veamar lemeze leattuna chad-shiva al di chaze lemezyeh
Ulguvrin gibbare-chayil di vechayeleh amar lechappata leshadrach meshach vaaved nego lemirme leattun nura yakidta
Bedayin guvrayya illech kefitu besarbalehon patteshehon vecharbelathon ulvushehon urmiv lego-attun nura yakidta
Kal-kovel dena min-di millat malka machtzefa veattuna eze yattira guvrayya illech di hassiku leshadrach meshach vaaved nego kattil himmon sheviva di nura
Veguvrayya illech telattehon shadrach meshach vaaved nego nefalu lego-attun-nura yakidta mechappetin
Edayin nevuchadnetztzar malka tevah vekam behitbehala ane veamar lehaddavrohi hala guvrin telata remena lego-nura mechappetin anayin veamrin lemalka yatztziva malka
Ane veamar ha-ana chaze guvrin arbea sherayin mahlechin bego-nura vachaval la-itay behon vereveh di reviaa dame levar-elahin
Bedayin kerev nevuchadnetztzar litra attun nura yakidta ane veamar shadrach meshach vaaved-nego avdohi di-elaha illaa puku veeto bedayin nafkin shadrach meshach vaaved nego min-go nura
Umitkanneshin achashdarpenayya signayya ufachavata vehaddavre malka chazayin leguvrayya illech di la-shelet nura begeshmehon usar reshhon la hitcharach vesarbalehon la sheno vereach nur la adat behon

Ane nevuchadnetztzar veamar berich elahahon di-shadrach meshach vaaved nego di-shelach malacheh vesheziv leavdohi di hitrechitzu alohi umillat malka shanniv vihavu geshmehon di la-yiflechun vela-yisgedun lechal-elah lahen lelahahon

Uminni sim teem di chal-am umma velishshan di-yemar shalu al elahahon di-shadrach meshach vaaved nego haddamin yitaved uvayeteh nevali yishtave kal-kovel di la itay ela achoran di-yikkul lehatztzala kidna
Bedayin malka hatzlach leshadrach meshach vaaved nego bimdinat bavel
Nevuchadnetztzar malka lechal-ammayya umayya velishshanayya dayerin bechal-ara shelamchon yisge
Atayya vetimhayya di avad immi elaha illaa shefar kadamay lehachavaya
Atohi kema ravrevin vetimhohi kema takkifin malchuteh malchut alam veshaltaneh im-dar vedar
Ana nevuchadnetztzar shele havet beveti veranan behechli
Chelem chazet vidachalinnani veharhorin al-mishkevi vechezve reshi yevahalunnani
Uminni sim teem lehanala kadamay lechol chakkime vavel di-feshar chelma yehodunnani
Bedayin allin chartumayya ashfayya kasdae vegazrayya vechelma amar ana kodamehon ufishreh la-mehodin li
Vead achoren al kadamay daniyyel di-shemeh belteshatzar keshum elahi vedi ruach-elahin kaddishin beh vechelma kadamohi amret
Belteshatzar rav chartumayya di ana yidet di ruach elahin kaddishin bach vechal-raz la-anes lach chezve chelmi di-chazet ufishreh emar
Vechezve reshi al-mishkevi chaze havet vaalu ilan bego ara verumeh saggi
Reva ilana utkif verumeh yimte lishmayya vachazoteh lesof kal-ara
Afyeh shappir veinbeh saggi umazon lecholla-veh techotohi tatlel chevat bara uvanfohi yeduran tzippare shemayya uminneh yittezin kal-bisra
Chaze havet bechezve reshi al-mishkevi vaalu ir vekaddish min-shemayya nachit
Kare vechayil vechen amar goddu ilana vekatztzitzu anfohi attaru afyeh uvaddaru inbeh tenud cheveta min-tachtohi vetzipperayya min-anfohi
Beram ikkar sharshohi beara shevuku uveesur di-farzel unchash bedita di vara uvtal shemayya yitztabba veim-cheveta chalakeh baasav ara
Livveh anasha yeshannon ulvav cheva yityehiv leh veshiva iddanin yachlefun alohi
Bigzerat irin pitgama umemar kaddishin sheelta ad-divrat di yindeun chayyayya di-shallit illaa bemalchut anasha ulman-di yitzbe yitteninnah ushfal anashim yekim alah
Dena chelma chazet ana malka nevuchadnetztzar veante belteshatzar pishre emar kal-kovel di kal-chakkime malchuti la-yachlin pishra lehodautani veante kahel di ruach-elahin kaddishin bach

Edayin daniyyel di-shemeh belteshatzar eshtomam keshaa chada verayonohi yevahalunneh ane malka veamar belteshatzar chelma ufishre al-yevahalach ane velteshatzar veamar mari chelma lesanach ufishreh learach
Ilana di chazayeta di reva utkif verumeh yimte lishmayya vachazoteh lechal-ara
Veafyeh shappir veinbeh saggi umazon lecholla-veh techotohi tedur chevat bara uvanfohi yishkenan tzippare shemayya
Nt-ante- hu malka di revat utkefte urvutach revat umtat lishmayya veshaltanach lesof ara

Vedi chaza malka ir vekaddish nachit min-shemayya veamar goddu ilana vechabbeluhi beram ikkar sharshohi beara shevuku uveesur di-farzel unchash bedita di vara uvtal shemayya yitztabba veim-chevat bara chalakeh ad di-shiva iddanin yachlefun alohi
Dena fishra malka ugzerat illaa hi di metat mari malka

Velach tardin min-anasha veim-chevat bara leheve medorach veisba chetorin lach yetaamun umittal shemayya lach metzabbein veshiva iddanin yachlefun alach ad di-tinda di-shallit illaya bemalchut anasha ulman-di yitzbe yitteninnah
Vedi amaru lemishbak ikkar sharshohi di ilana malchutach lach kayyama min-di tinda di shallitin shemayya
Lahen malka milki yishpar alach vachataach betzidka feruk vaavayatach bemichan anayin hen teheve archa lishlevetach
Kolla meta al-nevuchadnetztzar malka
Liktzat yarchin tere-asar al-hechal malchuta di vavel mehallech hava
Ane malka veamar hala da-hi bavel rabbeta di-ana venayetah levet malchu bitkaf chisni velikar hadri
Od milleta befum malka kal min-shemayya nefal lach amrin nevuchadnetztzar malka malchuta adat minnach
Umin-anasha lach tardin veim-chevat bara medorach isba chetorin lach yetaamun veshiva iddanin yachlefun alach ad di-tinda di-shallit illaya bemalchut anasha ulman-di yitzbe yitteninnah
Bah-shaata milleta safat al-nevuchadnetztzar umin-anasha terid veisba chetorin yechul umittal shemayya gishmeh yitztabba ad di sareh kenishrin reva vetifrohi chetzipperin
Veliktzat yomayya ana nevuchadnetztzar ayenay lishmayya nitlet umandei alay yetuv ulillaa barchet ulchay alma shabbechet vehadderet di shaltaneh shaltan alam umalchuteh im-dar vedar
Dayere ara kela chashivin uchmitzbeyeh aved bechel shemayya vedayere ara vela itay di-yemache videh veyemar leh ma avadte
Beh-zimna mandei yetuv alay velikar malchuti hadri vezivi yetuv alay veli haddavray veravrevanay yevaon veal-malchuti hatkenat urvu yattira husfat li
Kean ana nevuchadnetztzar meshabbach umromem umhaddar lemelech shemayya di chal-maavadohi keshot veorchateh din vedi mahlechin begeva yachil lehashpala
Belshatzar malka avad lechem rav leravrevanohi alaf velakovel alpa chamra shate
Belshatzar amar bitem chamra lehayetaya lemane dahava vechaspa di hanpek nevuchadnetztzar avuhi min-hechla di virushlem veyishton behon malka veravrevanohi sheglateh ulchenateh
Bedayin hayetiv mane dahava di hanpiku min-hechla di-vet elaha di virushlem veishtiv behon malka veravrevanohi sheglateh ulchenateh
Ishtiv chamra veshabbachu lelahe dahava vechaspa nechasha farzela aa veavna
Bah-shaata nefaka etzbean di yad-enash vechatvan lakovel nevrashta al-gira di-chetal hechla di malka umalka chaze pas yeda di chatva
Edayin malka ziohi shenohi verayonohi yevahalunneh vekitre chartzeh mishtarayin vearchubbateh da leda nakshan

Kare malka bechayil leheala leashfayya kasdae vegazrayya ane malka veamar lechakkime vavel di chal-enash di-yikre ketava dena ufishreh yechavinnani argevana yilbash vehamnicha di-dahava al-tzavvereh vetalti vemalchuta yishlat
Edayin allin kol chakkime malka vela-chahalin ketava lemikre ufishreh lehodaa lemalka
Edayin malka velshatzar saggi mitbahal veziohi shanayin alohi veravrevanohi mishtabbeshin
Malketa lakovel mille malka veravrevanohi levet mishteya allat anat malketa vaameret malka lealmin cheyi al-yevahaluch rayonach vezivach al-yishtanno

Itay gevar bemalchutach di ruach elahin kaddishin beh uvome avuch nahiru vesachletanu vechachma kechachmat-elahin hishtechachat beh umalka nevuchadnetztzar avuch rav chartummin ashfin kasdain gazrin hakimeh avuch malka

Kal-kovel di ruach yattira umanda vesachletanu mefashshar chelmin vaachavayat achidan umshare kitrin hishtechachat beh bedaniyyel di-malka sam-shemeh belteshatzar kean daniyyel yitkere ufishra yehachave
Bedayin daniyyel hual kodam malka ane malka veamar ledaniyyel nt-ante- hu daniyyel di-min-bene galuta di yehud di hayeti malka avi min-yehud
Veshimet alach di ruach elahin bach venahiru vesachletanu vechachma yattira hishtechachat bach
Uchan huallu kadamay chakkimayya ashfayya di-chetava dena yikron ufishreh lehodautani vela-chahalin peshar-milleta lehachavaya
Vaana shimet alach tikul pishrin lemifshar vekitrin lemishre kean hen tichul ketava lemikre ufishreh lehodautani argevana tilbash vehamnicha di-dahava al-tzavverach vetalta vemalchuta tishlat
Bedayin ane daniyyel veamar kodam malka mattenatach lach leheveyan unvazbeyatach leachoran hav beram ketava ekre lemalka ufishra ahodinneh
Ante malka elaha illaa malchuta urvuta vikara vehadra yehav linvuchadnetztzar avuch

Umin-revuta di yehav-leh kol ammayya umayya velishshanayya hao zayein vedachalin min-kodamohi diye-hava tzave hava katel vediye-hava tzave hava mache vediye-hava tzave hava marim vediye-hava tzave hava mashpil
Uchdi rim livveh verucheh tikfat lahazada hanchat min-karse malchuteh vikara hediu minneh

Umin-bene anasha terid velivveh im-cheveta shaviyev veim-aradayya medoreh isba chetorin yetaamunneh umittal shemayya gishmeh yitztabba ad di-yeda di-shallit elaha illaa bemalchut anasha ulman-di yitzbe yehakem alah
Veante bereh belshatzar la hashpelte livvach kal-kovel di chal-dena yedata

Veal mare-shemayya hitromamta ulmanayya di-vayeteh hayetiv kadamach veante veravrevanach sheglatach ulchenatach chamra shatayin behon velelahe chaspa-vedahava nechasha farzela aa veavna di la-chazayin vela-shamin vela yadin shabbachta velelaha di-nishmetach bideh vechal-orchatach leh la haddarta
Bedayin min-kodamohi sheliyaach passa di-yeda uchtava dena reshim
Udna chetava di reshim mene mene tekel ufarsin
Dena peshar-milleta mene mena-elaha malchutach vehashlemah
Tekel tekilta vemozanya vehishtechachatte chassir
Peres perisat malchutach vihivat lemaday ufaras
Bedayin amar belshatzar vehalbishu ledaniyyel argevana vehamnicha di-dahava al-tzavvereh vehachrizu alohi di-leheve shallit talta bemalchuta
Beh belelya ketil belshatztzar malka chasdaa
Vedaryavesh madaya kabbel malchuta kevar shenin shittin vetarten
Shefar kodam daryavesh vahakim al-malchuta laachashdarpenayya mea veesrin di leheon bechal-malchuta
Veella minnehon sarchin telata di daniyyel chad-minnehon di-leheon achashdarpenayya illen yahavin lehon tama umalka la-leheve nazik
Edayin daniyyel dena hava mitnatztzach al-sarchayya vaachashdarpenayya kal-kovel di ruach yattira beh umalka ashit lahakamuteh al-kal-malchuta

Edayin sarchayya vaachashdarpenayya hao vaayin illa lehashkacha ledaniyyel mitztzad malchuta vechal-illa ushchita la-yachlin lehashkacha kal-kovel di-meheman hu vechal-shalu ushchita la hishtechachat alohi
Edayin guvrayya illech amrin di la nehashkach ledaniyyel dena kal-illa lahen hashkachna alohi bedat elaheh
Edayin sarchayya vaachashdarpenayya illen hargishu al-malka vechen amrin leh daryavesh malka lealmin cheyi

Ityaatu kol sarche malchuta signayya vaachashdarpenayya haddavrayya ufachavata lekayyama keyam malka ultakkafa esar di chal-di-yive vau min-kal-elah veenash ad-yomin telatin lahen minnach malka yitreme legov aryavata
Kean malka tekim esara vetirshum ketava di la lehashnaya kedat-maday ufaras di-la tede
Kal-kovel dena malka daryavesh resham ketava veesara

Vedaniyyel kedi yeda di-reshim ketava al levayeteh vechavin petichan leh beilliteh neged yerushlem vezimnin telata veoma hu barech al-birchohi umtzalle umode kodam elaheh kal-kovel di-hava aved min-kadmat dena
Edayin guvrayya illech hargishu vehashkachu ledaniyyel bae umitchannan kodam elaheh

Bedayin kerivu veamrin kodam-malka al-esar malka hala esar reshamta di chal-enash di-yive min-kal-elah veenash ad-yomin telatin lahen minnach malka yitreme legov aryata ane malka veamar yatztziva milleta kedat-maday ufaras di-la tede
Bedayin ano veamrin kodam malka di daniyyel di min-bene galuta di yehud la-sam alach malka teem veal-esara di reshamta vezimnin telata beoma bae bauteh
Edayin malka kedi milleta shema saggi beesh alohi veal daniyyel sam bal leshezavuteh vead meale shimsha hava mishtaddar lehatztzaluteh
Bedayin guvrayya illech hargishu al-malka veamrin lemalka da malka di-dat lemaday ufaras di-chal-esar ukyam di-malka yehakem la lehashnaya
Bedayin malka amar vehayetiv ledaniyyel urmo legubba di aryavata ane malka veamar ledaniyyel elahach di ante palach-leh bitdira hu yeshezvinnach
Vehetayit even chada vesumat al-pum gubba vechatmah malka beizketeh uvizkat ravrevanohi di la-tishne tzevu bedaniyyel
Edayin azal malka lehechleh uvat tevat vedachavan la-hanel kadamohi veshinteh naddat alohi
Bedayin malka bishparpara yekum benagha uvhitbehala legubba di-aryavata azal
Uchmikreveh legubba ledaniyyel bekal atziv zeik ane malka veamar ledaniyyel daniyyel aved elaha chayya elahach di ante palach-leh bitdira hayechil leshezavutach min-aryavata
Edayin daniyyel im-malka mallil malka lealmin cheyi
Elahi shelach malacheh usagar pum aryavata vela chabbeluni kal-kovel di kadamohi zachu hishtechachat li veaf kadamach malka chavula la avdet
Bedayin malka saggi teev alohi uldaniyyel amar lehansaka min-gubba vehussak daniyyel min-gubba vechal-chaval la-hishtechach beh di hemin belaheh
Vaamar malka vehayetiv guvrayya illech di-achalu kartzohi di daniyyel ulgov aryavata remo innun benehon unshehon vela-meto learit gubba ad di-shelitu vehon aryavata vechal-garmehon haddiku
Bedayin daryavesh malka ketav lechal-ammayya umayya velishshanayya dayerin bechal-ara shelamchon yisge
Min-kodamay sim teem di bechal-shaltan malchuti leheon zayein vedachalin min-kodam elaheh di-daniyyel di-hu elaha chayya vekayyam lealmin umalchuteh di-la titchabbal veshaltaneh ad-sofa
Mesheziv umatztzil veaved atin vetimhin bishmayya uvara di sheziv ledaniyyel min-yad aryavata
Vedaniyyel dena hatzlach bemalchut daryavesh uvmalchut koresh parsaa
Bishnat chada levelshatztzar melech bavel daniyyel chelem chaza vechezve resheh al-mishkeveh bedayin chelma chetav resh millin amar
Ane daniyyel veamar chaze havet bechezvi im-lelya vaaru arba ruche shemayya megichan leyamma rabba
Vearba chevan ravrevan salkan min-yamma shanyan da min-da
Kadmayeta chearye vegappin di-neshar lah chaze havet ad di-meritu gappah untilat min-ara veal-raglayin keenash hokimat ulvav enash yehiv lah
Vaaru cheva achori tinyana damya ledov velistar-chad hokimat utlat ilin befummah ben shinnah vechen amrin lah kumi achuli besar saggi
Batar dena chaze havet vaaru achori kinmar velah gappin arba di-of gabbah vearbea reshin lecheveta veshaltan yehiv lah

Batar dena chaze havet bechezve lelya vaaru cheva reviaa dechila veemtani vetakkifa yattira veshinnayin di-farzel lah ravrevan achla umaddeka ushara beraglah rafsa vehi meshanneya min-kal-chevata di kadamah vekarnayin asar lah
Mistakkal havet bekarnayya vaalu keren achori zeera silkat benehen utlat min-karnayya kadmayata etakara kodamah vaalu ayenin keayene anasha bekarna-da ufum memallil ravrevan
Chaze havet ad di charsavan remiv veattik yomin yetiv levusheh kitlag chivar usar resheh kaamar neke karseyeh shevivin di-nur galgillohi nur dalik
Nehar di-nur naged venafek min-kodamohi elef alfin yeshammeshunneh veribbo rivvan kadamohi yekumun dina yetiv vesifrin petichu
Chaze havet bedayin min-kal millayya ravrevata di karna memallela chaze havet ad di ketilat cheveta vehuvad gishmah vihivat likedat eshsha
Ushar chevata hediv shaltanhon vearcha vechayyin yehivat lehon ad-zeman veiddan
Chaze havet bechezve lelya vaaru im-anane shemayya kevar enash ate hava vead-attik yomayya meta ukdamohi hakrevuhi
Veleh yehiv shaltan vikar umalchu vechol ammayya umayya velishshanayya leh yiflechun shaltaneh shaltan alam di-la yede umalchuteh di-la titchabbal
Etkeriyyat ruchi ana daniyyel bego nidne vechezve reshi yevahalunnani
Kirvet al-chad min-kaamayya veyatztziva eve-minneh al-kal-dena vaamar-li ufshar millayya yehodinnani
Illen chevata ravrevata di innin arba arbea malchin yekumun min-ara
Vikabbelun malchuta kaddishe elonin veyachsenun malchuta ad-alma vead alam almayya
Edayin tzevit leyatztzava al-cheveta reviayeta di-havat shanya kallehen dechila yattira shinnah di-farzel vetifrah di-nechash achla maddaka ushara beraglah rafsa
Veal-karnayya asar di vereshah veachori di silkat unfala kodamah telat vekarna dikken veayenin lah vefum memallil ravrevan vechezvah rav min-chavratah
Chaze havet vekarna dikken avda kerav im-kaddishin veyachla lehon
Ad di-ata attik yomayya vedina yehiv lekaddishe elonin vezimna meta umalchuta hechesinu kaddishin
Ken amar cheveta reviayeta malchu reviaa teheve veara di tishne min-kal-malchevata vetechul kal-ara utdushinnah vetaddekinnah
Vekarnayya asar minnah malchuta asra malchin yekumun veachoran yekum acharehon vehu yishne min-kadmaye utlata malchin yehashpil
Umillin letzad illaa yemallil ulkaddishe elonin yevalle veyisbar lehashnaya zimnin vedat veyityahavun bideh ad-iddan veiddanin uflag iddan
Vedina yittiv veshaltaneh yehadon lehashmada ulhovada ad-sofa
Umalchuta veshaltana urvuta di malchevat techot kal-shemayya yehivat leam kaddishe elonin malchuteh malchut alam vechol shaltanayya leh yiflechun veyishtammeun
Ad-ka sofa di-milleta ana daniyyel saggi rayonay yevahalunnani vezivay yishtannon alay umilleta belibbi nitret
Bishnat shalosh lemalchut belshatztzar hammelech chazon nira elay ani daniyyel achare hannira elay battechilla
Vaere bechazon vayehi biroti vaani beshushan habbira asher beelam hammedina vaere bechazon vaani hayiti al-uval ulay
Vaessa enay vaere vehinne ayil echad omed lifne hauval velo keranayim vehakkeranayim gevohot vehaachat gevoha min-hashshenit vehaggevoha ola baacharona
Raiti et-haayil menaggeach yamma vetzafona vanegba vechal-chayyot lo-yaamdu lefanav veen matztzil miyyado veasa chirtzono vehigdil
Vaani hayiti mevin vehinne tzefir-haizzim ba min-hammaarav al-pene chal-haaretz veen nogea baaretz vehatztzafir keren chazut ben enav
Vayyavo ad-haayil baal hakkeranayim asher raiti omed lifne hauval vayyaratz elav bachamat kocho
Uritiv maggia etzel haayil vayyitmarmar elav vayyach et-haayil vayeshabber et-shette keranav velo-haya choach baayil laamod lefanav vayyashlichehu artza vayyirmesehu velo-haya matztzil laayil miyyado
Utzfir haizzim higdil ad-meod uchatzmo nishbera hakkeren haggedola vattaalena chazut arba tachteha learba ruchot hashshamayim
Umin-haachat mehem yatza keren-achat mitztzeira vattigdal-yeter el-hannegev veel-hammizrach veel-hatztzevi
Vattigdal ad-tzeva hashshamayim vattappel artza min-hatztzava umin-hakkochavim vattirmesem
Vead sar-hatztzava higdil umimmennu huram hattamid vehushlach mechon mikdasho
Vetzava tinnaten al-hattamid befasha vetashlech emet artza veasta vehitzlicha
Vaeshmea echad-kadosh medabber vayyomer echad kadosh lappalmoni hamdabber ad-matay hechazon hattamid vehappesha shomem tet vekodesh vetzava mirmas
Vayyomer elay ad erev boker alpayim ushlosh meot venitzdak kodesh
Vayehi biroti ani daniyyel et-hechazon vaavaksha vina vehinne omed lenegdi kemare-gaver
Vaeshma kol-adam ben ulay vayyikra vayyomar gavriel haven lehallaz et-hammare
Vayyavo etzel amdi uvvoo nivatti vaeppela al-panay vayyomer elay haven ben-adam ki leet-ketz hechazon
Uvdabbero immi nirdamti al-panay artza vayyigga-bi vayyaamideni al-amdi
Vayyomer hinni modiacha et asher-yihye beacharit hazzaam ki lemoed ketz
Haayil asher-raita baal hakkeranayim malche maday ufaras
Vehatztzafir hassair melech yavan vehakkeren haggedola asher ben-enav hu hammelech harishon
Vehannishberet vattaamodna arba tachteha arba malchuot miggoy yaamodna velo vechocho
Uvacharit malchutam kehatem happoshim yaamod melech az-panim umevin chidot
Veatzam kocho velo vechocho veniflaot yashchit vehitzliach veasa vehishchit atzumim veam-kedoshim
Veal-sichlo vehitzliach mirma beyado uvilvavo yagdil uvshalva yashchit rabbim veal-sar-sarim yaamod uvefes yad yishshaver
Umare haerev vehabboker asher neemar emet hu veatta setom hechazon ki leyamim rabbim
Vaani daniyyel nihyeti venecheleti yamim vaakum vaeese et-melechet hammelech vaeshtomem al-hammare veen mevin
Bishnat achat ledaryavesh ben-achashverosh mizzera maday asher hamlach al malchut kasdim
Bishnat achat lemalcho ani daniyyel binoti bassefarim mispar hashshanim asher haya devar-Adonai el-yirmiya hannavi lemallot lecharvot yerushalam shivim shana
Vaettena et-panay el-adonay haelohim levakkesh tefilla vetachanunim betzom vesak vaefer
Vaetpalla la-Adonai elohay vaetvadde vaomra anna adonay hael haggadol vehannora shomer habberit vehachesed leohavav ulshomre mitzotav
Chatanu veavinu hirshanu umaradnu vesor mimmitzotecha umimmishpatecha
Velo shamanu el-avadecha hanneviim asher dibberu beshimcha el-melachenu sarenu vaavotenu veel kal-am haaretz
Lecha adonay hatztzedaka velanu boshet happanim kayyom hazze leish yehuda uloshve yerushalam ulchal-yisrael hakkerovim veharchokim bechal-haaratzot asher hiddachtam sham bemaalam asher maalu-vach
Adonai lanu boshet happanim limlachenu lesarenu velaavotenu asher chatanu lach
Ladonay elohenu harachamim vehasselichot ki maradnu bo
Velo shamanu bekol Adonai elohenu lalechet betorotav asher natan lefanenu beyad avadav hanneviim
Vechal-yisrael avru et-toratecha vesor levilti shemoa bekolecha vattittach alenu haala vehashshevua asher ketuva betorat moshe eved-haelohim ki chatanu lo
Vayyakem devaro asher-dibber alenu veal shoftenu asher shefatunu lehavi alenu raa gedola asher lo-neesta tachat kal-hashshamayim kaasher neesta birushalam
Kaasher katuv betorat moshe et kal-haraa hazzot baa alenu velo-chillinu et-pene Adonai elohenu lashuv meaonenu ulhaskil baamittecha
Vayyishkod Adonai al-haraa vayevieha alenu ki-tzaddik Adonai elohenu al-kal-maasav asher asa velo shamanu bekolo
Veatta adonay elohenu asher hotzeta et-ammecha meeretz mitzrayim beyad chazaka vattaas-lecha shem kayyom hazze chatanu rashanu
Adonay kechal-tzidkotecha yashav-na appecha vachamatcha meircha yerushalam har-kadshecha ki vachataenu uvaaonot avotenu yerushalam veammecha lecherpa lechal-sevivotenu
Veatta shema elohenu el-tefillat avdecha veel-tachanunav vehaer panecha al-mikdashcha hashshamem lemaan adonay
Hatte elohay aznecha ushama pekach enecha ure shommotenu vehair asher-nikra shimcha aleha ki lo al-tzidkotenu anachnu mappilim tachanunenu lefanecha ki al-rachamecha harabbim
Adonay shemaa adonay selacha adonay hakashiva vaase al-teachar lemaancha elohay ki-shimcha nikra al-ircha veal-ammecha
Veod ani medabber umitpallel umitvadde chattati vechattat ammi yisrael umappil techinnati lifne Adonai elohay al har-kodesh elohay
Veod ani medabber battefilla vehaish gavriel asher raiti vechazon battechilla muaf biaf nogea elay keet minchat-arev
Vayyaven vayedabber immi vayyomar daniyyel atta yatzati lehaskilcha vina
Bitchillat tachanunecha yatza davar vaani bati lehaggid ki chamudot atta uvin baddavar vehaven bammare
Shavuim shivim nechtach al-ammecha veal-ir kadshecha lechalle happesha ulhatem chattat ulchapper aon ulhavi tzedek olamim velachtom chazon venavi velimshoach kodesh kadashim
Veteda vetaskel min-motza davar lehashiv velivnot yerushalam ad-mashiach nagid shavuim shiva veshavuim shishshim ushnayim tashuv venivneta rechov vecharutz uvtzok haittim
Veachare hashshavuim shishshim ushnayim yikkaret mashiach veen lo vehair vehakkodesh yashchit am nagid habba vekitztzo vashshetef vead ketz milchama necheretzet shomemot
Vehigbir berit larabbim shavua echad vachatzi hashshavua yashbit zevach umincha veal kenaf shikkutzim meshomem vead-kala venecheratza tittach al-shomem
Bishnat shalosh lechoresh melech paras davar nigla ledaniyyel asher-nikra shemo belteshatztzar veemet haddavar vetzava gadol uvin et-haddavar uvina lo bammare
Bayyamim hahem ani daniyyel hayiti mitabbel shelosha shavuim yamim
Lechem chamudot lo achalti uvasar vayayin lo-va el-pi vesoch lo-sachti ad-melot sheloshet shavuim yamim
Uvom esrim vearbaa lachodesh harishon vaani hayiti al yad hannahar haggadol hu chiddakel
Vaessa et-enay vaere vehinne ish-echad lavush baddim umatnav chagurim bechetem ufaz
Ugviyyato chetarshish ufanav kemare varak veenav kelappide esh uzrootav umargelotav keen nechoshet kalal vekol devarav kekol hamon
Veraiti ani daniyyel levaddi et-hammara vehaanashim asher hau immi lo rau et-hammara aval charada gedola nafla alehem vayyivrechu behechave
Vaani nisharti levaddi vaere et-hammara haggedola hazzot velo nishar-bi koch vehodi nehpach alay lemashchit velo atzarti koach
Vaeshma et-kol devarav uchshami et-kol devarav vaani hayiti nirdam al-panay ufanay artza
Vehinne-yad naga bi vattenieni al-birkay vechappot yaday
Vayyomer elay daniyyel ish-chamudot haven baddevarim asher anochi dover elecha vaamod al-amdecha ki atta shullachti elecha uvdabbero immi et-haddavar hazze amadti marid
Vayyomer elay al-tira daniyyel ki min-hayyom harishon asher natatta et-libbecha lehavin ulhitannot lifne elohecha nishmeu devarecha vaani-vati bidvarecha
Vesar malchut paras omed lenegdi esrim veechad yom vehinne michael achad hassarim harishonim ba leazreni vaani notarti sham etzel malche faras
Uvati lahavincha et asher-yikra leammecha beacharit hayyamim ki-od chazon layyamim
Uvdabbero immi kaddevarim haelle natatti fanay artza veneelamti
Vehinne kidmut bene adam nogea al-sefatay vaeftach-pi vaadabbera vaomra el-haomed lenegdi adoni bammara nehefchu tziray alay velo atzarti koach
Vehech yuchal eved adoni ze ledabber im-adoni ze vaani meatta lo-yaamad-bi choach unshama lo nishara-vi
Vayyosef vayyigga-bi kemare adam vayechazzekeni
Vayyomer al-tira ish-chamudot shalom lach chazak vachazak uchdabbero immi hitchazzakti vaomra yedabber adoni ki chizzaktani
Vayyomer hayadata lamma-bati elecha veatta ashuv lehillachem im-sar paras vaani yotze vehinne sar-yavan ba
Aval aggid lecha et-harashum bichtav emet veen echad mitchazzek immi al-elle ki im-michael sarchem
Vaani bishnat achat ledaryavesh hammadi amdi lemachazik ulmaoz lo
Veatta emet aggid lach hinne-od shelosha melachim omdim lefaras veharvii yaashir osher-gadol mikkol uchchezkato veashro yair hakkol et malchut yavan
Veamad melech gibbor umashal mimshal rav veasa kirtzono
Uchamdo tishshaver malchuto vetechatz learba ruchot hashshamayim velo leacharito velo chemashlo asher mashal ki tinnatesh malchuto velaacherim millevad-elle
Veyechezak melech-hannegev umin-sarav veyechezak alav umashal mimshal rav memshalto
Ulketz shanim yitchabbaru uvat melech-hannegev tavo el-melech hatztzafon laasot mesharim velo-tatzor koach hazzeroa velo yaamod uzroo vetinnaten hi umvieha vehayyoldah umachazikah baittim
Veamad minnetzer sharasheha kanno veyavo el-hachayil veyavo bemaoz melech hatztzafon veasa vahem vehechezik
Vegam elohehem im-nesichehem im-kele chemdatam kesef vezahav bashshevi yavi mitzrayim vehu shanim yaamod mimmelech hatztzafon
Uva bemalchut melech hannegev veshav el-admato
Uvanav yitgaru veasfu hamon chayalim rabbim uva vo veshataf veavar veyashov veyitgare mauzzo
Veyitmarmar melech hannegev veyatza venilcham immo im-melech hatztzafon veheemid hamon rav venittan hehamon beyado
Venissa hehamon veram levavo vehippil ribboot velo yaoz
Veshav melech hatztzafon veheemid hamon rav min-harishon ulketz haittim shanim yavo vo bechayil gadol uvirchush rav
Uvaittim hahem rabbim yaamdu al-melech hannegev uvne paritze ammecha yinnasseu lehaamid chazon venichshalu
Veyavo melech hatztzafon veyishpoch solala velachad ir mivtzarot uzroot hannegev lo yaamodu veam mivcharav veen koach laamod
Veyaas habba elav kirtzono veen omed lefanav veyaamod beeretz-hatztzevi vechala veyado
Veyasem panav lavo betokef kal-malchuto visharim immo veasa uvat hannashim yitten-lo lehashchitah velo taamod velo-lo tihye
Veyasem panav leiyyim velachad rabbim vehishbit katzin cherpato lo bilti cherpato yashiv lo
Veyashev panav lemauzze artzo venichshal venafal velo yimmatze
Veamad al-kanno maavir noges heder malchut uvyamim achadim yishshaver velo veappayim velo vemilchama
Veamad al-kanno nivze velo-natnu alav hod malchut uva veshalva vehechezik malchut bachalaklakkot
Uzroot hashshetef yishshatfu millefanav veyishshaveru vegam negid berit
Umin-hitchabberut elav yaase mirma veala veatzam bimat-goy
Beshalva uvmishmanne medina yavo veasa asher lo-asu avotav vaavot avotav bizza veshalal urchush lahem yivzor veal mivtzarim yechashshev machshevotav vead-et
Veyaer kocho ulvavo al-melech hannegev bechayil gadol umelech hannegev yitgare lammilchama bechayil-gadol veatzum ad-meod velo yaamod ki-yachshevu alav machashavot
Veochle fat-bago yishberuhu vechelo yishtof venaflu chalalim rabbim
Ushnehem hammelachim levavam lemera veal-shulchan echad kazav yedabberu velo titzlach ki-od ketz lammoed
Veyashov artzo birchush gadol ulvavo al-berit kodesh veasa veshav leartzo
Lammoed yashuv uva vannegev velo-tihye charishona vechaacharona
Uvau vo tziyyim kittim venicha veshav vezaam al-berit-kodesh veasa veshav veyaven al-ozve berit kodesh
Uzroim mimmennu yaamodu vechillelu hammikdash hammaoz vehesiru hattamid venatnu hashshikkutz meshomem
Umarshie verit yachanif bachalakkot veam yode elohav yachaziku veasu
Umaskile am yavinu larabbim venichshelu becherev uvlehava bishvi uvvizza yamim
Uvhikkashlam yeazru ezer meat venilu alehem rabbim bachalaklakkot
Umin-hammaskilim yikkashlu litzrof bahem ulvarer velalben ad-et ketz ki-od lammoed
Veasa chirtzono hammelech veyitromem veyitgaddel al-kal-el veal el elim yedabber niflaot vehitzliach ad-kala zaam ki necheratza neesata
Veal-elohe avotav lo yavin veal-chemdat nashim veal-kal-eloha lo yavin ki al-kol yitgaddal
Veleeloha mauzzim al-kanno yechabbed veleeloha asher lo-yedauhu avotav yechabbed bezahav uvchesef uveven yekara uvachamudot
Veasa lemivtzere mauzzim im-eloha nechar asher yakkir yarbe chavod vehimshilam barabbim vaadama yechallek bimchir
Uvet ketz yitnaggach immo melech hannegev veyistaer alav melech hatztzafon berechev uvfarashim uvaoniyyot rabbot uva vaaratzot veshataf veavar
Uva beeretz hatztzevi verabbot yikkashelu veelle yimmaltu miyyado edom umoav vereshit bene ammon
Veyishlach yado baaratzot veeretz mitzrayim lo tihye lifleta
Umashal bemichmanne hazzahav vehakkesef uvchol chamudot mitzrayim veluvim vechushim bemitzadav
Ushmuot yevahaluhu mimmizrach umitztzafon veyatza bechema gedola lehashmid ulhacharim rabbim
Veyitta ahole appadno ben yammim lehar-tzevi-kodesh uva ad-kitztzo veen ozer lo
Uvaet hahi yaamod michael hassar haggadol haomed al-bene ammecha vehayeta et tzara asher lo-nihyeta mihot goy ad haet hahi uvaet hahi yimmalet ammecha kal-hannimtza katuv bassefer
Verabbim miyeshene admat-afar yakitzu elle lechayye olam veelle lacharafot lediron olam
Vehammaskilim yazhiru kezohar harakia umatzdike harabbim kakkochavim leolam vaed
Veatta daniyyel setom haddevarim vachatom hassefer ad-et ketz yeshottu rabbim vetirbe haddaat
Veraiti ani daniyyel vehinne shenayim acherim omdim echad henna lisfat hayeor veechad henna lisfat hayeor
Vayyomer laish levush habbaddim asher mimmaal lememe hayeor ad-matay ketz happelaot

Vaeshma et-haish levush habbaddim asher mimmaal lememe hayeor vayyarem yemino usmolo el-hashshamayim vayyishshava beche haolam ki lemoed moadim vachetzi uchchallot nappetz yad-am-kodesh tichlena chal-elle
Vaani shamati velo avin vaomra adoni ma acharit elle
Vayyomer lech daniyyel ki-setumim vachatumim haddevarim ad-et ketz
Yitbararu veyitlabbenu veyitztzarfu rabbim vehirshiu reshaim velo yavinu kal-reshaim vehammaskilim yavinu
Umeet husar hattamid velatet shikkutz shomem yamim elef matayim vetishim
Ashre hamchakke veyaggia leyamim elef shelosh meot sheloshim vachamishsha
Veatta lech lakketz vetanuach vetaamod legoralcha leketz hayyamin
Ezra: Uvishnat achat lechoresh melech paras lichlot devar-Adonai mippi yirmeya heir Adonai et-ruach koresh melech-paras vayyaaver-kol bechal-malchuto vegam-bemichtav lemor
Ko amar koresh melech paras kol mamlechot haaretz natan li Adonai elohe hashshamayim vehu-fakad alay livnot-lo vayit birushalam asher bihuda
Mi-vachem mikkal-ammo yehi elohav immo veyaal lirushalam asher bihuda veyiven et-bet Adonai elohe yisrael hu haelohim asher birushalam
Vechal-hannishar mikkal-hammekomot asher hu gar-sham yenasseuhu anshe mekomo bechesef uvzahav uvirchush uvivhema im-hannedava levet haelohim asher birushalam
Vayyakumu rashe haavot lihuda uvinyamin vehakkohanim vehalviyyim lechol heir haelohim et-rucho laalot livnot et-bet Adonai asher birushalam
Vechal-sevivotehem chizzeku videhem bichle-chesef bazzahav barchush uvabbehema uvammigdanot levad al-kal-hitnaddev
Vehammelech koresh hotzi et-kele vet-Adonai asher hotzi nevuchadnetztzar mirushalam vayyittenem bevet elohav
Vayyotziem koresh melech paras al-yad mitredat haggizbar vayyisperem lesheshbatztzar hannasi lihuda
Veelle misparam agartele zahav sheloshim agartele-chesef alef machalafim tisha veesrim
Kefore zahav sheloshim kefore chesef mishnim arba meot vaasara kelim acherim alef
Kal-kelim lazzahav velakkesef chameshet alafim vearba meot hakkol heela sheshbatztzar im healot haggola mibbavel lirushalam
Veelle bene hammedina haolim mishshevi haggola asher hegla nevuchadnetztzar melech-bavel levavel vayyashuvu lirushalam vihuda ish leiro
Asher-bau im-zerubbavel yeshua nechemya seraya reelaya mardochay bilshan mispar bigvay rechum baana mispar anshe am yisrael
